_comment: What Sudoku says aloud, for `npm run voice:record -- --skill sudoku --provider openai`.
Lesson intros are picked up from lessons.json. `prompts` are the two puzzle prompts and the
drills that name no number; each `templates` entry is a drill prompt, recorded once per number.
Must match locales/en.json word for word, or the clip is never found and live speech is used.
Reactions (right, wrong) come from the common pack.

templates.text: Where does {value} go? Scan the boxes.
Where does {value} go? Scan the rows and columns.
Use Pointing to find a place for {value}.
Use Claiming to find a place for {value}.
Use a Naked Pair to find a place for {value}.
Use a Hidden Pair to find a place for {value}.
Use an X-Wing to find a place for {value}.

prompts: Fill the grid so every row, column and box has each number once.
Fill the grid so every row, column and box has each picture once.
Find a row, column or box with one empty cell, and fill it.
Find a cell that can only be one number, and fill it.
